<!-- pr-reviewer: 33cf46fbe02052c0f67fdb1ffbf22919c3fb1bf2 -->
Needs changes before merge.

The source review found one missing evidence item. The dependency changes also need a maintainer check before a build.

What looks good:
- The library changes preserve the refusal branches and fallback values.
- The standalone binaries install a subscriber before they call the libraries.
- The new tests check event levels, targets, and filtering.
- The decision file explains the dependency edges. No snapshot PNG or output golden changes.

Local checks:
- Reviewed against current upstream main AGENTS.md at 780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6.
- Created an isolated worktree and ran the trial merge with that main. Git reported "Already up to date." No conflicts.
- Not built: Cargo.lock and crates/{cl,geometry,motion,sim,tools,ui}/Cargo.toml add dependency edges. The PR-reviewer rules require a maintainer check first. These crates already exist in the workspace dependency set; the new edges still require that check.
- Cargo build, tests, and clippy did not run. The test results in the PR body are author evidence, not reviewer results.
- Safety scope: diagnostics in geometry, multi-axis fallback, and stock simulation code change. Calculations, refusal decisions, posted output, and goldens do not change in this diff. Mutation checks did not run because the dependency rule prevents execution. No red/green mutation result is claimed.
- git diff --check reports CRLF line endings as trailing whitespace on the two changed lines in crates/ui/src/egui_app/shell.rs. This is not a blocking finding.

Requested before merge:
1. crates/ui/src/diag.rs:14: Add before/after screenshots to the PR body for the UI diagnostic changes. The review request requires this evidence for changes under crates/ui. Show the launch-terminal output before and after the change. Store screenshots only on the fork's images-only pr-screenshots branch, and link them from the PR body. Do not add images to the PR branch.

The PR remains a draft and receives needs-rework. After the evidence is supplied, a maintainer must check the dependency changes before execution checks can proceed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Addressed: the missing before/after launch-terminal screenshots for `crates/ui/src/diag.rs`.

The PR body now links both screenshots. They are stored only on the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch.
Image commit: `da945c1bf2c1225c326274280fbed9ac4104ec74`.

The screenshots show actual app launches with `--ui legacy` at `CAMCRAFT_LOG=info` and `off`.
The before executable restores only the two old native diagnostic calls. The after executable uses the current head.

The existing pin `diag::tests::diag_lines_are_tracing_events_at_their_level` was RED with the old calls and GREEN after restoration.
All nine test steps of `cargo xtask gate quick --base upstream/main` passed.
The gate and touched-crate clippy failed only on the existing unused `MIN_LABEL_PX` constant at `crates/ui/src/egui_app/painted.rs:115`.

Head: `33cf46fbe02052c0f67fdb1ffbf22919c3fb1bf2` (unchanged). The plain push reported everything up to date.
This finding required PR evidence only. No source change or PR-branch commit was needed.

Please re-review the screenshot evidence on this head. The PR remains a draft.

<!-- pr-reviewer: 33cf46fbe02052c0f67fdb1ffbf22919c3fb1bf2 -->
Not built - needs a maintainer look.

The later "Addressed" comment permits this review of the same head. The earlier screenshot finding is now met. I withdraw that requested change.

What looks good:
- I opened both linked screenshots. Before, the refusal prints at both `info` and `off`. After, it prints a timestamp, WARN level and `camcraft_ui` target at `info`. It stays quiet at `off`. Both versions report exit code 2.
- The PR body explains how the before executable was made. The images are linked from the fork's `pr-screenshots` branch. The PR adds no images.
- The source changes preserve refusal branches, fallback values and calculations. The standalone binaries install the subscriber before library calls.
- The new tests check warning levels, targets and filtering. The decision file explains the added dependency edges.

Local review results:
- I read the current upstream main rules at `780b0a25a40606dc3cc96f56ab0b2c8ecb1093e6`.
- I created `.claude/worktrees/review-2110` and trial-merged `upstream/main`. Git reported "Already up to date." The PR is MERGEABLE.
- Not built: `Cargo.lock` and `crates/{cl,geometry,motion,sim,tools,ui}/Cargo.toml` add dependency edges. The reviewer rules require a maintainer check before execution. The two dependencies already exist in the workspace; this PR adds their use in these crates.
- Cargo build, tests and clippy did not run. No GitHub runner was used. The results in the PR body remain author evidence.
- Safety-related files contain diagnostic changes in geometry, multi-axis fallbacks and stock simulation. No posted G-code, geometry calculation, collision decision or simulation result changes. No goldens move.
- Mutation checks did not run under the dependency restriction. I claim no reviewer red/green result. Execution checks remain pending.

Requested source or evidence changes: none.

The review has no remaining source or evidence blockers. The label is `needs-maintainer`, not a build or test pass. A maintainer must check the dependency edges before execution checks proceed.

A maintainer will approve and merge by hand.

Maintainer decision of 2026-11-16 (question dialog): the build script, workflow and dependency changes of this PR are accepted. The PR now gets a review with a build. It merges when that review is clean.

The head 33cf46fbe conflicts with origin/main a8bb30f0c. The only conflict is in Cargo.lock. A clean merge of that file is mechanical. I set the conflicts label. The needs-maintainer label stands. The author re-merges main into the branch.
